fields.System.Title: CNT-201 — Issue a count task
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a counter, I want to be given the next location to count, so that I can work
through a list without a supervisor directing each one.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given open count tasks, when I request work, then one is assigned and locked to me.
  • - Given the assigned task, then it shows the location and which products and batches are
  • expected to be there — but not their quantities.
  • - Given ten counters requesting work from ten tasks, then each task goes to exactly one
  • counter.
  • - Given a task assigned to someone else, then I cannot submit a result for it.
  • - Given assignment, then the location freeze from
  • [CNT-204](CNT-204-freeze-location.md) begins.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting |
| Tables | count_task |
| Risks | Two counters on one location ([doc 09 §4.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · concurrency |
